results.question: which table stores customer's orders
results.sql: SELECT invoices FROM customers JOIN employees ON customers.SupportRepId = employees.EmployeeId

results.question: How many customers are there
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t2.CustomerId) AS customer_count 
FROM employees AS t1 
JOIN customers AS t2 ON t1.SupportRepId = t2.CustomerId

results.question: what are the top 5 countries that customers come from?
results.sql:
SELECT BillingCountry 
FROM invoices 
GROUP BY BillingCountry 
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId) DESC 
LIMIT 5

results.question: List all albums and their corresponding artist names
results.sql: SELECT T1.Title, T2.Name FROM albums AS T1 INNER JOIN artists AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId WHERE T4.Name = 'Rock'

results.question: Find all tracks with a name containing "What" (case-insensitive)
results.sql: SELECT t.Name FROM tracks AS t WHERE LOWER(t.Name) LIKE '%what%'

results.question: Get the total number of invoices for each customer
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerId) AS Total_Invoices FROM customers c INNER JOIN invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId

results.question: Find the total number of invoices per country:
results.sql:
SELECT 
  BillingCountry,
  COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceId) AS TotalInvoicesPerCountry
FROM 
  invoices
GROUP BY 
  BillingCountry

results.question: List all invoices with a total exceeding $10:
results.sql: SELECT i.InvoiceId, i.Total FROM invoices i WHERE i.Total > 10000

results.question: Find all invoices since 2010 and the total amount invoiced:
results.sql:
SELECT 
    i.InvoiceId,
    i.Total AS TotalInvoiced
FROM 
    invoices i
JOIN 
    invoice_items ii ON i.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId
WHERE 
    ii.InvoiceId IS NOT NULL AND 
    strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) >= 2010
LIMIT 5

results.question: List all employees and their reporting manager's name (if any)
results.sql: SELECT e.LastName, e.FirstName, COALESCE(e2.Title, 'No manager') AS ManagerName FROM employees e LEFT JOIN employees e2 ON e.ReportsTo = e2.EmployeeId

results.question: Get the average invoice total for each customer
results.sql: SELECT AVG(T3.Total) AS avg_invoice_total FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN invoices AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId INNER JOIN ( SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS Total FROM invoices GROUP BY CustomerId ) AS T3 ON T2.CustomerId = T3.CustomerId

results.question: Find the top 5 most expensive tracks (based on unit price)
results.sql:
SELECT 
    t.Name AS TrackName,
    t.UnitPrice AS UnitPrice
FROM 
    tracks t
JOIN 
    invoice_items ii ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
GROUP BY 
    ii.UnitPrice
ORDER BY 
    ii.UnitPrice DESC
LIMIT 5

results.question: List all genres and the number of tracks in each genre:
results.sql:
SELECT 
    g.Name AS GenreName,
    COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount
FROM 
    genres g
JOIN 
    tracks t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
GROUP BY 
    g.Name

results.question: Get all genres that do not have any tracks associated with them:
results.sql:
SELECT g.Name 
FROM genres AS g 
LEFT JOIN tracks AS t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId 
WHERE t.TrackId IS NULL LIMIT 1

results.question: There are 3 tables: artists, albums and tracks, where albums and artists are linked by ArtistId, albums and tracks are linked by AlbumId, Can you find the top 10 most popular artists based on the number of tracks
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t3.ArtistId) FROM tracks AS t1 INNER JOIN albums AS t2 ON t1.AlbumId = t2.AlbumId INNER JOIN artists AS t3 ON t2.ArtistId = t3.ArtistId GROUP BY t3.Name ORDER BY COUNT(t1.TrackId) DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: List all customers from Canada and their email addresses:
results.sql:
SELECT 
    c.FirstName, 
    c.LastName, 
    c.Email
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
WHERE 
    c.Country = 'Canada'

results.question: Find the customer with the most invoices
results.sql:
SELECT customers.FirstName, customers.LastName
FROM customers
JOIN invoices ON customers.CustomerId = invoices.CustomerId
GROUP BY customers.CustomerId
ORDER BY COUNT(invoices.InvoiceId) DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: Find the customer who bought the most albums in total quantity (across all invoices)
results.sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM customers AS c INNER JOIN invoices AS i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId INNER JOIN invoice_items AS ii ON i.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(ii.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Hint: album quantity is found in invoice_items, Find the top 5 customers who bought the most albums in total quantity (across all invoices):
results.sql: SELECT customers.FirstName, customers.LastName, SUM(invoice_items.Quantity) AS total_albums FROM customers JOIN invoices ON customers.CustomerId = invoices.CustomerId JOIN invoice_items ON invoices.InvoiceId = invoice_items.InvoiceId GROUP BY customers.CustomerId ORDER BY Sum(invoice_items.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: Find the top 5 customers who spent the most money overall, Hint: order total can be found on invoices table, calculation using invoice_items detail table is unnecessary
results.sql:
SELECT 
    c.FirstName AS CustomerFirstName,
    c.LastName AS CustomerLastName,
    SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
GROUP BY 
    c.FirstName, c.LastName
ORDER BY 
    TotalSpent DESC
LIMIT 5

results.question: Get all playlists containing at least 10 tracks and the total duration of those tracks:
results.sql:
SELECT T3.Name, SUM(T2.Milliseconds) AS TotalDuration 
FROM tracks AS T1 
JOIN playlist_track AS T2 ON T1.TrackId = T2.TrackId 
JOIN playlists AS T3 ON T2.PlaylistId = T3.PlaylistId 
GROUP BY T3.Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.TrackId) >= 10

results.question: Identify artists who have albums with tracks appearing in multiple genres:
results.sql:
SELECT T1.Name 
FROM albums AS T1 
INNER JOIN tracks AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.AlbumId 
INNER JOIN genres AS T3 ON T2.GenreId = T3.GenreId 
WHERE T3.GenreId IN (
  SELECT T2.GenreId 
  FROM tracks AS T2 
  GROUP BY T2.GenreId 
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.GenreId) > 1
)
